# MM-P3-L1-SB02 - Maintenance manual - Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-SB02

Scope
- Routine preventative maintenance and inspection for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) covering mechanical, media handling, and wear components directly affecting blast performance and safety.
- Refer to related documents: MM-P3-L1-SB02-S3, SB-1027, SOP-P3-L1-04.

Tools
- Torque wrench capable of applying the specified blast wheel liner bolt torque.
- Standard hand tools and lifting aids as required for safe access.
- PPE per SOP-P3-L1-04.

Procedure
- Isolate and lock out equipment per SOP-P3-L1-04 prior to service. Verify energy is controlled and media feed is secured.
- Remove access panels to expose blast wheel assembly and liner. Inspect liner for wear, cracks, or loosening.
- Tighten blast wheel liner bolts using torque wrench to the blast wheel liner bolt torque for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) is 65 N·m. Confirm each bolt reaches specified torque and mark or tag as inspected.
- Inspect shot media hopper and separator for obstructions and wear. Add media when inventory reaches operating threshold to maintain consistent blasting; the shot media top-up interval for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) is 45 hours. Record top-up in maintenance log.
- Inspect seals, doors, and collection points. Replace any components that do not meet acceptance criteria below.
- Reassemble panels, remove lockout, and perform functional check per SOP-P3-L1-04. Observe for abnormal noise or vibration; if present, stop and investigate.

Acceptance criteria
- All blast wheel liner bolts torqued to blast wheel liner bolt torque for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) is 65 N·m and show no evidence of loosening after functional test.
- Shot media replenished according to the shot media top-up interval for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) is 45 hours and media flow is consistent.
- No visible cracks or critical wear on liner or blast wheel components. Any component failing inspection must be serviced or replaced in accordance with MM-P3-L1-SB02-S3 and SB-1027 before return to service.
